IC1: Provision of written informed consent (by patient or appropriate designee according to local regulations) prior to any study specific procedures.
IC2: Aged 18 years or older, male [OR] or female.
IC3: History of stable angina pectoris with angiographic evidence of CAD (diameter stenosis = 50%) in major, i.e., left main [OR], left anterior descending [OR], left circumflex [OR], and right coronary arteries.
IC5: History of coronary revascularization, i.e., percutaneous coronary intervention [OR] (PCI) or coronary artery bypass graft (CABG), [NOT] not including the elective PCI during the index hospitalization
IC6: Documented history of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
IC7: Post-procedural residual diameter stenosis of the treated lesions  < 20% in patients with stent implantation [OR] or < 50% in those with balloon angioplasty
IC8: Post-procedural thrombolysis in myocardial infarction (TIMI) grade 3 flow in treated vessels
IC9: Negative cardiac troponin test before the index elective PCI.
IC10: Taking Clopidogrel  75 mg daily dose for at least 7 days [OR] or taking Clopidogrel 75 mg daily dose for less than 7 days but with 300 to 600 mg Clopidogrel loading dose before PCI.
IC11: Taking acetylsalicylic acid [OR] (ASA) 100 mg daily treatment for at least 7 days or taking ASA 100 mg daily dose for less than 7 days but with 300 mg ASA loading dose before PCI.
IC12: have a negative urine or blood pregnancy test at enrolment and prior to randomization;
IC13: currently be using a hormonal contraceptive and agree to continue its use in addition to using double-barrier local contraception (i.e., intra-uterine device plus spermicidal and condom for male partner) from screening through study completion.
